native: Original serialized XML and raw xfrm attribute strings remain separate from computed coordinates. No Editor/IR/CAD conversion.

sourceCoordinate.nativeIntegerPolicy: raw decimal strings always retained; arithmetic only safe finite integers

layout: slide width/height divided by 36000 is LAYOUT mm only; real-world scale remains UNSCALED

matrix.rotation: raw ST_Angle retained; candidate degrees=raw/60000 clockwise in y-down source frame
matrix.complex: Nonuniform group scaling combined with non-half-turn rotation is an affine candidate requiring native app semantics verification. Raw chain and full quad/axis vectors preserved.

geometry: circle/ellipse center and two affine axis vectors
text: Every native paragraph has ordered r/fld/br items; concatenate runs within paragraph, br is newline, join paragraphs by newline. Original run XML/rPr/color/font retained. Baseline/layout/theme/font unresolved stays HUMAN_CHECK_REQUIRED.
ledger: Each spTree direct child plus group children and explicit cSld background gets source row. Shape+text gets separate component rows. Unsupported component view includes source identity/reasons/next action. Every inventory count explained is not evidence of supported target retention.
packageFailures: Missing part/relationship/native slide size, duplicate ZIP name or slide reference, unsafe ZIP/relationship path, CRC/XML/DTD/namespace failure fail atomically with InventoryError.code/source; no result adoption.
origin: Caller-reported provenance label only. SYNTHETIC_GENERIC/G generic and VDRAW_NATIVE labels do not validate semantics; semanticMetadataVerified=false.
